mistake.headline:
Bell out in front.
Bending over for it.
mistake.body: Most guys are doing these wrong. If the weight is ahead of you, you end up bending over to reach it.

image.alt: Dan squatting down to a kettlebell between his legs, chest up

fix.headline:
Bell between
your legs.
fix.body: Feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes forward. Squat down with a straight back, grab it, stand up. [em]Squeeze your glutes at the top.[/em]

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the kettlebell deadlift
items: Bell between your feet, not in front of them.
Squeeze your glutes at the top. No hip thrust.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy who picks up a kettlebell like a dropped phone.
